title: Tokopedia Product Search Scraper
description: Scrape product search results from Tokopedia (Indonesia's largest marketplace). Extracts product name, price, discount, shop info, ratings, reviews, and more.

searchTerms.title: Search Keywords
searchTerms.description: Keywords to search for on Tokopedia (e.g., 'laptop gaming', 'sepatu nike')

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape. Each page has up to 50 products. Max 50 pages.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Sort results by a specific field.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price (IDR)
minPrice.description: Filter products with price above this value. Leave 0 for no filter.

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (IDR)
maxPrice.description: Filter products with price below this value. Leave 0 for no filter.

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Only return products with this rating or higher. 0 = any rating.

officialStore.title: Official Store Only
officialStore.description: Only return products from official/brand stores.

location.title: Location
location.description: Filter by seller city (e.g., 'Jakarta', 'Surabaya'). Leave empty for all.
